title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) Based Algorithm for Accurate Estrogen Receptor (ER) and Progesterone Receptor (PR) Analysis in Breast Cancer Diagnostics: Potential to be a Crucial Aid in Routine Workflow.
authors: Pai, Kanthilatha; Singh, Brij Mohan Kumar; Udupa, Chethana Babu; Pai, Madhavi; Verma, Vani; Jha, Sumit; Aatre, Kiran; Mishra, Purnendu; Godkhindi, Vishwapriya Mahadev; Sharma, Swati; Singh, Gursevak; Mathur, Shubham; Modi, Akash; Kumar, Rajiv
one_liner_zh: 该文用AI算法对乳腺癌ER/PR免疫组化染色进行自动评分，属于临床病理诊断应用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Scoring of estrogen receptor (ER) and progesterone receptor (PR) expression in breast cancer is critical for identifying patients who would benefit with hormonal therapy. Since manual scoring of immunohistochemistry (IHC) is influenced by pathologist experience, fatigue, inter-observer variability, and subjectivity, artificial intelligence (AI)-based algorithms, trained on large datasets can aid to improve diagnostic accuracy. METHODOLOGY: This study evaluated an AI-based algorithm for ER and PR IHC scoring in 297 ER and 293 PR cases of invasive breast carcinoma and compared the scores with that of pathologists (two senior and two junior) A pre-trained automated algorithm (Mimansa) identified region of interest and provided the scoreswhich was compared with the consensus score of pathologists-ground truth(GT).Concordance was evaluated using Cohen's kappa and F1 score. RESULTS: For ER IHC, GT scores included 169 strong positive, 31 low positive, and 98 negative cases. Agreement with GT was 99% and 98% for senior pathologists, 97% for the AI algorithm, and 95% and 93% for junior pathologists. The algorithm correctly classified all strong positive cases but showed discordance in 16 low-score cases, with four false negatives and ten false positives. Notably, it identified two true positive cases missed by all pathologists.For PR IHC, agreement rates were 98% and 97% for senior pathologists, 92% for the algorithm, and 93% and 91% for junior pathologists. The algorithm achieved perfect accuracy in strong positive cases but produced 16 false negatives and eight false positives among low-score cases. Cohen's kappa values were 0.91 (ER) and 0.84 (PR). CONCLUSION: The AI algorithm demonstrated high concordance with expert consensus, performing comparably to senior pathologists and outperforming junior pathologists in several metrics. It shows promise as a supportive second-reader tool, particularly in low-positive cases where diagnostic errors may significantly impact patient management.
abstract_zh: 背景：乳腺癌中雌激素受体（ER）和孕激素受体（PR）表达的评分对于识别可能从激素治疗中获益的患者至关重要。由于免疫组织化学（IHC）的人工评分受病理学家经验、疲劳、观察者间差异和主观性影响，基于人工智能（AI）的算法，在大型数据集上训练，可有助于提高诊断准确性。方法：本研究评估了一种基于AI的算法，用于297例ER和293例PR浸润性乳腺癌病例的IHC评分，并将其评分与病理学家（两名高级和两名初级）的评分进行比较。一种预训练的自动化算法（Mimansa）识别感兴趣区域并提供评分，该评分与病理学家的共识评分（即金标准，GT）进行比较。一致性通过Cohen's kappa和F1分数评估。结果：对于ER IHC，GT评分包括169例强阳性、31例低阳性和98例阴性病例。与GT的一致性，高级病理学家分别为99%和98%，AI算法为97%，初级病理学家为95%和93%。该算法正确分类了所有强阳性病例，但在16例低评分病例中出现不一致，包括四例假阴性和十例假阳性。值得注意的是，它识别出了所有病理学家遗漏的两例真阳性病例。对于PR IHC，高级病理学家的一致性率分别为98%和97%，算法为92%，初级病理学家为93%和91%。该算法在强阳性病例中达到完美准确性，但在低评分病例中产生16例假阴性和八例假阳性。Cohen's kappa值分别为0.91（ER）和0.84（PR）。结论：AI算法与专家共识表现出高度一致性，在多项指标上与高级病理学家相当，并优于初级病理学家。它显示出作为支持性第二阅片工具的潜力，尤其是在低阳性病例中，这些病例的诊断错误可能显著影响患者管理。
